logoLetterforms: bold stencil-cut sans serif — letters have geometric cuts (industrial/military stencil DNA) but balanced with broad strokes
logoColorBlocking: split — first word 'AXIS' green, second + third words 'AUTOS LTD' black
logoTagline: USED CARS SPECIALISTS — thin condensed sans below wordmark, full-width centered
logoMood: bold, distinctive, slightly utilitarian — but the stencil character demands restraint elsewhere so it stays the focal point

fontPick.heading: Manrope
fontPick.rationale: Manrope (clean geometric sans, neutral) won't compete with the stencil character of the logo. IBM Plex Sans body is a modern grotesque pairing — distinct from Inter/Open Sans/Source Sans 3 already used in registry. Brand new pair across the catalogue.

designNote: Stencil wordmark is loud; the layout must be calm. Minimalist whitespace + sentence-case lets the logo be the loudest thing on the page. Going UPPERCASE on h1-h4 would double the stencil energy and turn shouty — explicitly avoided.
